content.comment_body: Is anyone aware if drivers exist for [product_name] in the [product_name] Runtime files, so I can control [product_name] from a PC? Thanks, [user_name]

Drivers aren't included directly in Runtime, but you configure the connection while creating your [product_name] project. Depending on your [product_name] version, choose either [version_no] or, if offered, select [product_name] as the device partner.
Just to confirm: Can I set up the project with the connections to [product_name] in [product_name] Portal, deploy the finished project to the user's PC, and everything works as intended? Thanks,

You do need configuration software such as [product_name] Advanced to create your project. After that, you'll need the Runtime—[product_name] HMI runtime is built in. If you plan to run the project on a PC, you'll need [product_name] Runtime Advanced. Set up your connections within the project.
